description: This file defines the 'Country' class in the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation' namespace, which manages country data including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving country information from the database within the OpenCart admin system.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class for managing country data in the OpenCart administrative interface, including CRUD operations and querying country information.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Inserts a new country record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates an existing country record identified by country_id.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Deletes a country record from the database based on country_id.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific country by its ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country data using the ISO 2-code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country data using the ISO 3-code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries, potentially filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Returns the total number of countries matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Returns count of countries associated with a specific address format ID.

search-terms: Country class in Opencart admin model
